description: PR-AP continuation: ordinary-play chain through stew-cost and last-checker grounded absence, verifying grammatical refusal realization, then thank + look-toward and one further natural action.

scenarios.initial_objective: Learn the missing-patrol route, pursue it, investigate, return, observe, reread the board, bind the Guard Captain, receive a legitimate first-ask answer, inspect the referenced roster, look around, ask the tavern runner what stew costs, glance back at the notice board, ask who last checked that board, thank the runner and look toward the gate line, then take one more natural action.
scenarios.content: frontier_gate notice board, tavern-runner stew-cost grounded absence, board last-reader grounded absence, grammatical refusal realization
player_prompts: I step closer and read the notice board carefully.
Fine. I'll follow the missing patrol rumor along that northwest mud track.
I'll head back to the gate.
I read the notice board again.
I turn to the Guard Captain. "What's being done about the missing patrol?"
If the watch already has a commander on this, I'll check the roster board the serjeant is watching.
I look around the gate again after that.
I step over to the tavern runner and ask what the stew costs.
I glance back at the notice board after that.
I step back to the tavern runner and ask who last checked that board.
I thank the runner and look toward the gate line again.
I walk a few steps along the muddy gate line and listen.
